duplicate_handling: Preserve Critesion pusillum, var. pubens and H. riehlii as synonyms to the existing species concept. Route var. flexuosum to distinct H. flexuosum; do not collapse H. intercedens into H. pusillum.
follow_up: Maintain H. pusillum accepted name. Preserve specimen/photo identity holds; check source vouchers before reassigning historical flexuosum or intercedens records. Do not install separate cards or alter photo records in taxonomy lane.
